about.title: About
about.description: Engineer who turns ambiguous requirements into working systems, judges where AI fits, and builds client consensus on the basis for technical decisions. At a global consulting firm, provided technical support for a major life insurer's company-wide operations transformation and helped a life insurance group's IT subsidiary bring RAG in-house. Also takes on independent AI engagements as a Forward Deployed Engineer, including an AI tutor PoC for an education company, designed and built single-handedly. Previously built data-analysis and AI PoCs at a European consulting firm (FY2024 Corporate Award for an internal AI chat), drove data-driven decisions through data analysis at an advertising agency, and proposed solutions at an IT company.
